answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, while evidence of coordinated equivocation links their faults into one event. For k colluding identities, the penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), so a sybil swarm rapidly destroys escrowed capital; detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making control uneconomic. This remains true whether agents wander through willow networks or exploit karst-like topology.
